name: zipbox

modes.label: Per-second fixed VM sizes
modes.note: Published hourly list rates (zipbox.ai/pricing and /docs/pricing, 2026-09-28): Tiny $0.0068, Small $0.0137, Medium $0.0274, Large $0.0548 per hour, "Machine time metered by the second while running"; the "~$5/$10/$20/$40 /mo" always-on figures are just hourly x ~730, not a cap or discount. "Paused boxes cost $0". Larger sizes via support.
modes.note (append): Platform-proxied LLM calls billed at provider cost + 3%; bring-your-own subscription bills machine time only. Paused = disk archived, meter stops; restore boots the same disk on fresh hardware (no memory state).

plans.name: Prepaid pay as you go
plans.note: Prepaid credit, no subscription; minimum top-up $5; credits never expire; a positive balance is required to boot. At $0 balance a 1-hour grace window, then running boxes are paused (archived). Concurrency limit not published.

features.ip_note: Egress/IP and proxy options not documented; each microVM has its own public hostname and network.

caveats: Displayed $5/$10/$20/$40 monthly equivalents are not stated as billing caps or always-on discounts; use hourly rates.
Pause saves disk; does not establish full running-memory snapshot retention.
Concurrency unverified: no limit on concurrent boxes is published (null = unknown, not unlimited); max session length, egress charge and public IPv4 pricing are not published. SSH is IPv6-only.
LLM/API calls using platform keys draw the same credit balance and are additional; own model subscriptions separate.
Signup credit verified 2026-09-28: "$25 in credit once it proves it's human - one grant per person". Credits are prepaid and non-refundable.
No independent runtime/account test or performance measurement performed.
Idle auto-stop not documented: pause is manual (dashboard / status bar); the only automatic pause is 1 hour after the balance hits $0. auto_stop_idle left null (no idle discount applied).

Features check 2026-09-28: desktop true -> null. Homepage only says "Full Chrome on the machine, not headless ... you watch every click" and the box is "streamed to your browser"; docs/access lists only the browser terminal and SSH, and no desktop/VNC/X view is documented. Fork/clone of a box and Docker-inside are undocumented (null). Firecracker ("Each sandbox is a Firecracker microVM", docs/security) => no /dev/kvm in guests (firecracker tests/integration_tests/security/test_nv.py).

fleet.verification: New credit grant requires proving human (method unspecified), one per person; positive balance to boot. Card not required to boot; top-ups by card/crypto via Stripe and saved card for auto-refill.
fleet.notes: Machine sizes and credit balance are published but account machine count/vCPU/GPU quotas and increase procedure are not. Requesting a larger machine is not evidence of a larger fleet entitlement.
